offering_description.value: Provides satellite broadband and communications services, satellite and ground terminal equipment, and secure government networking and defense communications systems. Customers include governments and militaries, airlines, maritime operators, enterprises and consumers. It designs and builds its own satellites, antennas and terminals and operates the networks.

primary_products.value: satellite terminals and antennas; satellites; ground network equipment; secure tactical data links; encryption devices

primary_services.value: in-flight connectivity; fixed satellite broadband; maritime and enterprise connectivity; managed government network services

customer_segment.value: B2G: US and allied militaries and government agencies; B2B: commercial airlines, maritime operators, enterprises, telecom carriers; B2C: residential satellite internet subscribers

end_markets.value: defense and government; commercial aviation; maritime; residential broadband; enterprise and mobility

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband and in-flight connectivity service plans; product sales: terminals, antennas, and network equipment; project or contract: government systems development and defense contracts
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates satellites and ground networks, selling bandwidth to airlines, consumers and governments; OEM / manufacturer: builds terminals, antennas and secure communications gear for government and commercial customers; service provider: delivers managed connectivity and network services
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and global aviation and maritime routes

specialization.value: related lines: satellite broadband services, government and defense systems, and communication networking equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: airlines, governments, militaries, and enterprise customers; partners / resellers: retail internet service partners and telecom resellers; online: direct consumer satellite internet sign-ups

regulatory_exposure.value: high: satellite spectrum licensing by FCC and international bodies, export controls (ITAR), government contracting rules
